reviews.title: Expensive App With Export Issues
reviews.text:
I purchased this app expecting a smooth video editing experience, but unfortunately it has been very disappointing. The app is quite expensive, yet it is not even helping me export my videos properly. After spending time editing, the export either fails or does not work as expected, which defeats the entire purpose of using a video editing app.

For the price being charged, basic features like exporting videos should work reliably. Because of this issue, the app has not been useful for me at all. At this point, I feel I should receive a refund for the amount I paid.
